synth.notes:
Ring A1/A2 move y by 6 and carry blocks on the beam. If any pushed or carried block would leave the colour-4 field, the whole move cancels (the block A1 [arm] no_change case: blocks hit the field top).
Beam A4/A3 changes w by 6. Hook = any block on the beam rows at x == tip-4, with no tag check. All blocks fully on the beam then follow the tip; this is the step-87 todo drag. An unhooked extend pushes blocks in the swept strip.
A blocked horizontal chain leaves the beam moving alone. Tags: the hooked next block becomes collected; a collected block that is off the beam reverts.
HUD row 53: 3s = (n-1)//3, n = non-click actions, remembered per returned frame (fallback 3*bars+1, or 0). Legend centres turn 0 while collected. Clicks do nothing.
Unconfirmed: the hidden-accumulated-state hypothesis was not needed; the only hidden state is the HUD action count.
